T: On your left. Pass the noodles.
D: Steve Rogers uncovers a conspiracy inside S.H.I.E.L.D. and comes face to face with an old friend.
P: Serve the mains when Steve adds another item to his catch-up list.
S: a DC classic after the morning run
Smoked half-pork, half-beef sausages split and grilled, in buns with chilli, mustard and chopped onion.
Mini bagels toasted and topped with cream cheese, smoked salmon, red onion and capers. Split and toast 12 mini bagels.
Sam letting Steve and Natasha hide out at his house
Small buttermilk pancakes stacked with butter and maple syrup, with crisp bacon on the side.
M: Thai food written on Steve's list of things he missed
Chicken thighs stir-fried with garlic, chilli, fish sauce and holy basil, served over jasmine rice with a fried egg.
Beef chuck simmered 3 hours with onion, carrots and potatoes in stock and red wine, served in bowls with bread.
W: Cherry and blueberry pie with a lattice top in red, white and blue, baked at 190C for 45 minutes.
K: Steve visits his own museum exhibit
An old soda fountain drink: cherry syrup, a splash of lemon and fizzing soda water.

s.note: a DC classic after the morning run
s.how: Simmer 300g beef mince with 1 onion, 2 tsp chilli powder, 200g crushed tomatoes and 125ml water for 25 minutes. Split 4 smoked half-pork, half-beef sausages and grill 6 minutes. Serve in 4 buns with the chilli, yellow mustard and chopped onion.
Split and toast 12 mini bagels. Spread with 250g cream cheese and top with 200g smoked salmon, thin red onion rings, capers and black pepper.

m.note: Thai food written on Steve's list of things he missed
m.how: Stir-fry 600g minced or chopped chicken thighs with crushed garlic and chopped red chilli in a hot wok. Add a splash of fish sauce and a pinch of sugar, then toss through Thai basil. Serve over jasmine rice with a crisp fried egg on top.

w.how: Toss 400g frozen cherries and 200g blueberries with 100g sugar and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice top. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes until bubbling. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: Steve visits his own museum exhibit
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice. Add 3 tbsp maraschino cherry syrup and a squeeze of lemon to each and top with 200ml soda water. Add a cherry.
